description: This file defines the Manufacturer class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. It contains methods to handle adding, editing, and deleting manufacturers, primarily by scheduling related tasks such as updating manufacturer lists, info, and associated products.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class handling manufacturer-related events, scheduling tasks for add, edit, and delete operations.

methods.name: addManufacturer
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update manufacturer list and info after a manufacturer is added.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update manufacturer list, info, and related products after a manufacturer is edited.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update manufacturer list, delete manufacturer, and update related products after a manufacturer is deleted.
